name: Bernecebaráti (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of red and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Bernecebaráti (a red and blue shield with a monogram and a heart, with yellow mantling) above a yellow scroll inscribed BERNECEBARÁTI.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Bernecebaráti arms with mantling and scroll
